cases.rationale: The night street crop contains an identifiable illuminated traffic-signal head near the central building. The tall starburst lights are street lamps, the island marker is not a stop sign, and the roadside railings are not bench seating. No identifiable people, vehicles, animals, portable objects, food, furniture or appliances satisfy the remaining definitions. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual person in a black shirt occupies the foreground. The large game scene is projected onto the wall, so its depicted performer and objects are not actual crop objects and the projection is not a standalone TV. The small device below the projection has projector-like lens/body context rather than an identifiable laptop or monitor; its support is a work/equipment surface rather than an eating table. The remaining definitions have no identifiable instances. No unresolved category ambiguity.

An adult and a child are clearly visible on the grass, with a green flying disc in flight beside the child. The slatted park seat at the right edge is an identifiable bench part. The distant white peaked shade structures could be umbrellas or fixed pavilion canopies; umbrella identity remains unclear (25). Trees and shrubs are planted in the ground, not identifiable pots. The other definitions show no identifiable objects.

A real black-and-white cat lies across a computer desk, with standalone displays and an actual computer keyboard visible. Bound books/notebooks stand at the right of the main monitor. The small pale rounded object partly hidden beside the cat at the right could be a computer mouse, but its body is insufficiently exposed, so mouse (64) is unclear. The upright handset/button apparatus is a desk telephone rather than a mobile phone or identifiable handheld remote; the desk is not a dining table. No other category object is identifiable.

A person holds a full-size skateboard with its deck, trucks and wheels visible; a white passenger car is clearly present at the upper right. The wrist protection is not a baseball fielding glove. At the far left a cropped circular rim/body could belong to a bowl-like open vessel, but too little is visible to identify its function, leaving bowl (45) unclear. It has no visible plant-and-pot context. The remaining definitions have no identifiable instances.

Actual people accompany a herd along the road, and a sedan and passenger SUV are visible beside the wall. The small brown herd animals have shaggy bodies and dark narrow heads; their limited detail does not resolve sheep versus goats, so sheep (18) is unclear. Their size and morphology do not support cattle, horses or the other defined animals. The roadside debris, masonry and overhead wires do not establish any of the remaining object categories.

A person stands holding the line associated with the colorful diamond-shaped kite assembly along the right edge. These are actual kite bodies, not birds or umbrellas. The background is grass and unpotted trees; the white edge object at the left is not identifiable furniture or a traffic sign. No remaining category object is identifiable and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Several actual people are present around a wooden outdoor eating table. The bread-supported brown food in the foreground could be a sausage/hot dog in a bun or another sandwich; the filling is insufficiently resolved for the frankfurter distinction, leaving sandwich (48) and hot dog (52) unclear. A small yellow seating part at the lower right could belong to a bench or an individual chair, leaving bench (13) and chair (56) unclear. Clothing and napkins do not establish bags or utensils; no other defined category is identifiable.

A human hand is visible beside the cutting board. The central round crust with red sauce is an actual pizza in preparation. Shredded carrots occupy the upper-right board, a knife lies at the lower right, and a spoon rests in the sauce pan at the upper right. Open bowl-like vessels include the blue-rimmed dish and small sauce container; these are not identifiable drinking cups or bottles. The green bell pepper, mushrooms, ham, onion and tomatoes do not satisfy the other named food definitions. The preparation counter is not a dining table. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A real brown bear head and shoulder fill the left foreground, and a real gull stands on a rock in the upper center. The bear is an animal rather than a stuffed teddy bear or costume. Rock, grass and flowing water fill the rest of the crop; no other defined category is identifiable. No unresolved category ambiguity.

Actual people are visible on the snowy training slope, including a child standing and an adult kneeling. The narrow separated equipment under their boots and the tips at the lower right are skis rather than an identifiable snowboard. The cone and ski poles are not any defined category, and the background rails are fencing rather than a bench. No other defined object is identifiable and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The frosted carrot-and-raisin cake portion has visible cake crumb and cream-cheese-style frosting. A black plastic fork with tines is visible at the right. The orange carrot-shaped garnish may be an actual carrot portion or a confectionery decoration, which the crop does not resolve; carrot (51) remains unclear. The blue support is a plate rather than a bowl, and the handwritten cake label is loose card rather than a book. The small surrounding tabletop patch does not establish dining-table identity. No other category object is identifiable.
